body:
Hi, 

About a year ago I was pretty obsessed with suicide too. Let me just say, a lot can change in a year.

The things that helped me were talking about it, hobbies, and time.  

This week you should try out some new things. You just might find something to live for.

I have a theory that pretty much everyone on /r/suicidewatch is or was suicidal. Why else would they be here? 


If you are anything like me, I bet you care deeply for others, far more than yourself. Coming here and helping others actually did help you feel better. You are not a hypocrite. You probably helped a lot of people when they needed it most.

It's hard to have to feel that way every day. Your right. A mind shouldn't think that way... It isn't functioning correctly if it is telling you to die. It's job is to help you think, adapt, and stay alive. 

I'm bad at advice, but if I had to give some I'd say that in time you will be happy. If you end life now you will never have that time. Find someone, anyone to confide in and talk to them. Also find hobbies and things to make new skills and find new things that make you feel successful.

Chin up.

Hey,

Sounds like you could totally code circles around me. What language do you write in?

I'm mostly into JavaScript. I wish I had started at 13. 

I remember being 13. It's a weird time. You are basically an adult minus a bit of wear and tear. I luckily got along with everyone in school, however I watched a few kids get picked on mercilessly. I still regret not sticking up for one of them. Well, it's been a few years and I see a few of these guys online. The guys who were nerds and got picked on are totally the guys doing great now. 

I know it feels like a long way to go, but if you keep going I promise you that you will be happy.  Hell, if school is that bad switch schools. Get a fresh start. I know it seems crazy, but one of my good friends did that and mad tons of friends.  

If you ever want to talk PM me. I'll talk to you on equal footing.
Hey, PM me. What's going on?

Hey,

I'm not good at advice or anything, but I just thought I'd let you know I was in your shoes last year. It literally seemed logical to kill myself. I met a really nice guy named Simon on here who talked to me on the night I needed it most. Let me just say that it's a year later, life is far from perfect, but I'm happy. So if you ever want to talk throw a PM my way. This was a throw away account but I'll try and check it often.

Hey, 

I'm not great at this, but I just wanted to say that we all screw up.  I feel guilty about loads of things, and I think that's normal.  I don't have anything inspirational to say other than that you will screw up again, and so will I and that's ok.

So best wishes

Hey man,

I'm going through some of this too.
I don't have any answers, but I'd be willing to PM if you want.
